items.title: A locally Noetherian space is locally connected
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a locally Noetherian topological space is locally connected (author lemma at source lines 1582-1586, label lemma-locally-Noetherian-locally-connected). The proof (source lines 1588-1601) replaces a neighbourhood by its intersection with a Noetherian one, decomposes it into finitely many irreducible components and takes the union of those containing the point, which is connected and a neighbourhood (proof lines 1588-1600). The connected neighbourhood construction is the content. H3.
